Frequently asked questions

What is Parsley’s Clinical Lab Review?

Clinical Lab Review is a 30-minute virtual visit with a board-certified clinician who interprets your recent blood test results in the context of your symptoms, history, and lifestyle — to give you a clear plan for what to do next. You can order Parsley's Advanced Lab Panel of 80+ biomarkers, or bring recent lab test results drawn within the last 6 months from another provider.
